title: Almost all orbits of the Collatz map attain almost bounded values
summary: Proves that Col_min(N) <= f(N) for almost all N (logarithmic density) for any f -> infinity. Uses renewal processes on 3-adic groups.

title: The Collatz Conjecture is a Two-Bit Problem
summary: Reduces Collatz to ergodic mixing of two indicator bits. Proves structural velocity bounds and corroborates with NIST randomness tests.

title: On The Collatz Conjecture: Topological and Ergodic Approach
summary: Studies Collatz under topological and ergodic perspectives including thermodynamic formalism. Shows recurrence implies periodicity.

title: Functional Analysis Approach to the Collatz Conjecture
summary: Associates a linear operator with the Collatz map. Shows absence of non-trivial cycles implies hypercyclicity.

title: The 3x+1 Problem: An Overview
venue: The Ultimate Challenge: The 3x+1 Problem, AMS
summary: Comprehensive survey of the 3x+1 problem including dynamical systems, ergodic theory, and computational approaches.
